prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1368; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was stopped at the light when struck from behind by a third-party sedan. Both drivers reported as shaken but able to exit vehicles. Police report requested and photos of both vehicles obtained from the insured.

Entry 2: Spoke with the claimant by phone. She reports neck and shoulder pain on the right side, with stiffness developing overnight. She has not been represented by an attorney and says she is handling the matter on her own. Explained the claims process, the need for medical documentation, and that she may choose her own treating provider. Recorded her statement.

Entry 3: Vehicle damage appraisal completed for the claimant's car. Rear bumper, trunk lid, and tail light assembly damaged; possible frame involvement noted. Shop estimate requested. Rental coverage confirmed under the claimant's policy and a rental vehicle was offered for the repair period.

Entry 4: Claimant provided medical records from urgent care showing diagnosis of a right shoulder strain with range of motion limitation. Physical therapy referral noted in the records. Requested a copy of the complete treatment plan and any imaging results. Reminded claimant to keep receipts for out-of-pocket medical and rental expenses.

Entry 5: Liability review in progress. Third-party driver admitted at scene to following too closely and was cited. Insurer for the at-fault party has been notified and has acknowledged the claim. Reserves reviewed and adjusted to reflect the reported injury and vehicle damage. Next step is to schedule a follow-up with the claimant once the physical therapy evaluation is complete.
